missing: null or blank with a status/reason field. Never a substitute zero.
money_unit: integer cents unless a column name says otherwise
time: UTC unix seconds plus America/Los_Angeles ISO with PST/PDT abbreviation

columns.net_r: net_pnl / planned stop-risk R0. R0 is not a guaranteed maximum loss
columns.strategy_result: POSITIVE | NEGATIVE | FLAT. Distinct from terminal_result
columns.exit_vol_category: 1-7 or blank. Blank is insufficient history, not category 1
columns.observed_entry_close_cents: bid close at the signal. Not the assumed 78 cent fill

candidate_audit.csv.na: reason blank only when status is CANDIDATE

events.csv.equity_cents: cash + receivables + open principal at cost. Realized accounting, not a bid mark
